verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's marketing says it automates routine work, moves cases between agents and the team, and keeps every decision defensible. The docs also describe an automatic audit trail of all work, which suggests automated decisions can be handed to humans with their records kept. But there is only a thin marketing-level mention of agent-to-human handoff, with no documented flow for inspecting or overriding an automated decision. missing for 10: explicit inspect/override controls for automated dispositions, documentation that the original AI evidence and rationale are kept alongside the human override, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can inspect and override an automated remediation decision while preserving its original evidence and rationale

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.

Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
